description: This file contains unit tests for the HL7SourceValidator class in the OpenMRS project, validating the correctness of HL7 source object field lengths.

classes.name: HL7SourceValidatorTest
classes.description: A test class for HL7SourceValidator, extending BaseContextSensitiveTest, containing test methods for source validation.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Tests that the HL7SourceValidator successfully validates a source with correct field lengths.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Tests that the HL7SourceValidator fails validation when the source has an overly long name.
